description: Results for "Nonlinear Programming-based multi-period approach for Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow" article is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Diogo Reis, Diogo Pereira (INESC TEC). This dataset contains the results achieved for the article "Nonlinear Programming-based multi-period approach for Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow" . Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
